tests.description: Base repo files exist and docs JSON parse successfully.
Snapshot key stability is deterministic for the same daily source row identity.
Source product keys stay stable across dates for the same locality, outlet, product code, and category code.
Different outlets produce different source product identities.
Different localities produce different source product identities.
Blank promo values normalize to numeric zero while raw promo text is preserved.
Enrichment is reused for existing source products unless revalidation is required.
Minor name drift avoids re-enrichment while major name drift triggers revalidation.
Missing products are retained and marked inactive rather than deleted.
The sample Bulgarian fixture imports successfully and yields deterministic enrichment output.
Bulgarian enrichment maps into deterministic canonical English metadata.
English display formatting is deterministic and supports partial-data fallback.
New enrichment rows automatically include English metadata and pending translation slots.
English backfill is idempotent and does not overwrite existing values.
Translated display values are stored and marked complete for supported languages.
Translation reruns do not overwrite or retranslate cached values.
Translation failures are recorded without erasing successful translations.
Per-run translation limits cap translation work for cost control.
Bulgarian input normalization and tokenization preserve deterministic matching terms.
Specific Bulgarian free-text matches the expected enriched source product.
Scoring behavior rewards exact and attribute-aware matches over looser candidates.
Price aggregation returns the cheapest current store result from the latest snapshots.
Ambiguity detection flags close or weak matches without invoking AI.
The query service endpoint returns matched products and cheapest-store results.
The query service endpoint validates missing query input.
AI fallback reranks already-ambiguous deterministic candidates without acting as the primary matcher.
Semantic enrichment batch jobs store flat SQL-compatible semantic profile records.
Embedding generation stores deterministic flat embedding records and skips existing ones.
Feedback capture stores flat feedback events.
Direct embedding generation returns deterministic storage payloads.
Daily aggregation computes correct product and category averages, minimums, maximums, and counts.
Daily aggregation is idempotent and append-only for the same date.
Product history endpoint returns ordered history rows.
Category trends endpoint returns ordered aggregate rows.
Query parsing extracts intent, constraints, and product hints deterministically.
Constraint filtering applies deterministic price and category limits.
Ranking surfaces better cheap-query candidates first.
Unified query engine returns flat ranked results and applied filters.
Unified query engine endpoint validates missing query input.
Firestore-to-SQL sync maps flat rows correctly and remains idempotent.
Firestore-to-vector sync indexes embeddings only once.
Phase 5 mobile scaffold files and required dependencies exist in app/mobile.
Mobile bootstrap wires backend API configuration and Firestore/in-memory repository selection.
Flutter widget tests cover the search flow, shopping list creation, and watchlist removal flows.
Native Android and iOS runner verification remains pending until real mobile runner checks are completed with generated Firebase options.
Phase 5.5 shared UI system files and recent-activity support exist in the mobile app.
Home, results, and product-detail screens expose the required growth hooks and savings-first affordances.
Flutter widget tests cover polished growth hooks and key one-thumb mobile flows.
Native Flutter execution remains pending until Android and iOS runtime checks complete with real Firebase options.
Flutter localization configuration, delegates, supported locales, and ARB files are wired correctly.
Flutter widget tests render the app shell correctly in English and Bulgarian and fall back safely for unsupported locales.
Localized widget tests cover result rendering and watchlist rendering without localization-context crashes.
Repo-level static localization tests verify l10n files, delegates, supported locales, and widget-test coverage.
Streamed ZIP ingest dedupes duplicate rows and enriches only valid net-new products.
Streamed CSV ingest reuses enrichment for known products and only enriches true net-new rows.
Pre-enrichment dedupe reuses one enrichment result for repeated chain-plus-product-code rows inside one ingest batch.
Different normalized source chains keep separate pre-enrichment dedupe buckets even when product codes match.
Rows without a usable chain-plus-product-code enrichment key fall back safely instead of collapsing unrelated products.
Deterministic cross-chain canonicalization merges obvious same-product variants while keeping flat canonical-product records and mappings.
Deterministic cross-chain canonicalization does not merge different sizes or clearly different variants.
Canonical product mappings remain stable across reruns for the same source products.

Deterministic canonicalization keeps infant-formula stages, count families, kids age bands, reserve tiers, flavors, colors, pack-count variants, explicit year-or-age markers, and normalized volume-or-weight markers in separate groups when those markers differ.
Deterministic canonicalization keeps explicit numeric ranges separate while allowing equivalent slash and hyphen range formatting to merge.
Latest snapshot resolution selects the newest available ZIP in the lookback window.
Grok escalation runs only on ambiguous match cases and remains budget-controlled.
Remote embedding backfill stores vectors for canonical products.
Watchlist alert detection produces notification-ready payloads for price drops.
Daily production orchestration runs once for a snapshot date and skips repeat reruns.
Analytics tracking stores flat search and unmatched-query events.
Zero-result Phase 4 queries are captured as normalized demand logs with locality context.
Matched queries do not create Phase 7 demand logs.
Manual can't-find-this feedback stores both feedback history and demand logs.
Demand aggregation merges duplicate logs and separates automatic versus manual frequencies.
Demand embeddings and clusters are rebuilt deterministically in batch.
Top-demand and trending-demand services return ranked unmet-demand outputs.
Single-store optimization selects the cheapest common-store basket plan.
Multi-store optimization can select a cheaper split basket when preferences allow it.
Preference weighting can favor fewer stores over the cheapest split basket.
Store and combination limits bound the basket search space deterministically.
Weak or unmatched basket items are carried without failing the whole request.
The optimize-basket endpoint validates missing query input.
Recurring watchlist detection computes interval and confidence from repeated price-drop cadence.
Daily watchlist evaluation computes significance, good-deal flags, target hits, and list diffs.
Cooldown-aware nudges suppress repeat notifications within the configured window.
Daily per-user watchlist summaries aggregate low-spam insight counts.
Target-price updates upsert watchlist profile state deterministically.
Watchlist summary and insights endpoints return current intelligence state.
RevenueCat entitlement sync stores premium tier state and analytics events deterministically.
Entitlement status falls back safely and premium activation is reflected in tier state.
Explicit multi-store optimizer requests are gated for free-tier users and allowed for premium users.
Target-price alert updates are gated by monetization entitlement state.
Alert delivery blocks synced free-tier users and allows premium users.
Flutter widget tests cover paywall rendering and premium ad suppression.
The repository deployment audit enumerates all runtime env vars and Flutter dart-define inputs referenced by code.
The deployment handoff documents required external accounts, missing configs, and production blockers.
Firestore-backed persistence preserves flat backend records, deletes stale rows on save, and keeps environment-based backend selection explicit.
Firestore-backed runtime keeps ingest, aggregation, and entitlement flows idempotent across reloads.
Docs JSON validation still passes after Phase 11 deployment documentation updates.
Basic repo verification still passes after Phase 11 deployment documentation updates.
Canonical query generation produces deterministic corrected and expanded query fields.
Conservative fuzzy correction handles simple typos without introducing ambiguous rewrites.
Synonym mapping expands configured terms into canonical query tokens.
The matcher improves deterministic accuracy when canonical synonym expansion is available.
Demand aggregates can deterministically learn typo synonyms without duplicating existing mappings.
Unresolved canonical warnings can be normalized into durable queue records with structured product evidence.
Canonical disambiguation fingerprints stay stable across reruns and A/B ordering changes.
Existing adjudication decisions are reused by pair fingerprint and hard-marker conflicts are excluded from the queue scaffolding path.
The opt-in adjudication runner reports dry-run metrics without making model calls.
Valid LLM disambiguation responses are persisted with model, prompt-version, decision-source, and confidence provenance.
Malformed LLM disambiguation responses are rejected without persisting partial decisions.
Repeated adjudication runs reuse cached decisions and avoid new model calls for already decided fingerprints.
Human disambiguation decisions persist with review note and reviewer provenance.
Human decisions outrank LLM decisions for the same fingerprint while preserving prior LLM provenance.
Human-reviewed fingerprints are reused across adjudication reruns without model calls and without canonical output mutation.
Effective canonical decisions are applied only to a reversible view with merge, block, skipped-conflict, unchanged, and audit outputs.
Controlled apply mode produces an applied grouping map without mutating canonical products or canonical mappings.
Ingest results include a dry-run disambiguation application preview.
A new canonical fingerprint triggers one enrichment call and caches the validated result.
An existing canonical fingerprint reuses cached enrichment without a new model call.
Invalid enrichment output is rejected and not persisted.
Strict schema validation rejects uncontrolled fields and normalizes stored values.
Controlled category hierarchy validation rejects invalid category combinations.
Canonical grouping remains unchanged whether enrichment exists or not.
The enrichment prompt exposes the strict schema and controlled category tree.
Canonical product readers can explicitly combine canonical truth, applied view, and enrichment.
Deterministic list and search helpers filter canonical product views by enrichment-backed category, brand, base product, flavor, and attributes.
Enrichment analytics expose coverage, category, brand, base-product, flavor, and ingest-run summaries.
Canonical-truth-only readers reject enrichment-backed filters instead of blurring layer boundaries.
Live enrichment default intent is enabled unless the environment explicitly disables it.
Live enrichment remains non-blocking when enabled but XAI_API_KEY is missing.
Reader and analytics helpers do not mutate canonical products or canonical mappings.
Product detail handlers return stable product-facing fields with canonical id, canonical name, markers, enrichment, and explicit layer mode.
Product search handlers default to canonical_with_enrichment and return bounded deterministic results.
Invalid layer-mode input is rejected safely instead of silently switching layers.
Enrichment-backed API filtering works across supported category, brand, base-product, flavor, and attribute filters.
Facet handlers return deterministic counts for the supported enrichment dimensions.
Enrichment analytics summary handlers expose coverage and category, brand, base-product, and flavor rollups.
Product API handlers do not mutate canonical products or canonical mappings.
Applied-view data is only returned when the caller explicitly requests an applied-view layer.
Missing canonical product ids return bounded not-found responses instead of crashing.
Exact and simple shopping-list items resolve into ranked canonical candidates.
Close competing candidates return ambiguous instead of forcing a single resolved output.
Items with no viable candidates return unresolved without crashing the request.
Ranked candidate outputs include deterministic match reasons.
limit_per_item is respected without changing the underlying ambiguity policy.
Invalid layer-mode inputs are rejected safely.
Empty shopping-list requests are rejected safely.
Shopping-list resolution accepts both string items and object items with text.
Shopping-list resolution does not mutate canonical products, mappings, or enrichment cache.
All-resolved shopping lists produce optimization-ready basket plans.
Ambiguous carry-top-n planning keeps optimization ready while requiring confirmation.
Ambiguous require-confirmation planning blocks optimization readiness.
Unresolved exclude planning keeps optimization ready while preserving unresolved items.
Unresolved block planning disables optimization readiness.
Requested quantity and simple volume/count markers are preserved in ready items.
Ambiguous carried-candidate behavior respects the configured top-N policy deterministically.
Basket planner execution does not mutate canonical products, mappings, or enrichment cache.
Canonical price lookup returns bounded latest price records and deterministic best-price selection.
Canonical products with no mapped current price records return explicit missing status.
Canonical products with only old snapshots return explicit stale status.
Chain and store filters apply deterministically on derived identifiers from existing snapshot truth.
Promo-aware latest-price lookup picks the lowest valid current effective price.
The price lookup handler validates bounded request errors safely.
Basket-plan price lookup collects ready items and carried ambiguous candidates.
Price lookup does not mutate basket plans, canonical products, mappings, or raw price snapshots.
Complete single-store baskets win over incomplete cheaper baskets when the missing-item penalty applies.
Actual totals exclude penalty while score totals include it for ranking.
Missing and stale-excluded prices are explicit in item warnings.
Requested quantity multiplies selected line totals.
Planner-blocked basket plans prevent optimization.
Ambiguous cheapest-candidate policy auto-selects and warns.
Ambiguous require-confirmation policy blocks optimization.
Optimizer output currency is EUR.
Optimizer execution does not mutate basket plans or price lookups.
Basket optimize endpoint validates bad optimizer input.
Deterministic tie-breaking uses chain id after score, coverage, and actual-total ties.
Stale-only candidate chains still produce explicit stale warnings and penalty scoring.
Two-store splits can beat single-store and be recommended.
Tiny savings below threshold do not recommend multi-store.
Worse-coverage multi-store options do not beat single-store recommendation.
Missing-item penalty affects score_total but not actual_total.
max_stores equals 2 bounds evaluated combinations.
Deterministic multi-store tie-breaking uses store id order.
Ambiguous cheapest-candidate policy works across store combinations.
Stale prices are excluded by default in multi-store options.
Basket optimize endpoint remains single-store by default.
Basket optimize endpoint returns combined multi-store result when requested.
Multi-store output currency remains EUR.
Multi-store optimizer does not mutate basket plan or price lookup inputs.
Single-store explanation headline names the recommended chain.
Multi-store explanation headline names both chains.
Savings text appears when multi-store saves money.
Missing item notes are generated from optimizer warnings.
Ambiguous auto-selection notes are generated.
Limitations include travel not included for multi-store explanations.
include_explanation true adds explanation to endpoint results.
Omitted include_explanation preserves the old endpoint response shape.
Explanation currency remains EUR.
Explanation builder does not mutate optimizer results.
The shared flat backbone exposes meal foundation collections for ingredient hierarchy, units, conversions, ingredient rules, and bridge mappings.
Ingredient family, category, and ingredient records can be written and queried deterministically with localized names and runtime-safe field validation.
Seeded generic unit conversions and ingredient-specific piece rules convert recipe quantities into edible quantities deterministically.
Edible quantities convert into conservative purchasable quantities using ingredient yield rules and explicit purchase units.
Product-to-ingredient mapping resolution prefers stronger mapping types and exposes normalized ingredient price candidates from mapped canonical products.
Ingredient cost projection follows the explicit fallback ladder from exact local mapped price to other-store mapped price to category average to ingredient estimate.
Postgres transition architecture document exists with explicit Postgres, Firestore, and Firebase Functions ownership boundaries.
Dedupe-first ingest contract is documented for USDA, Open Food Facts, retailer products, ingredients, recipes, and components.
Enrichment contract keeps LLM use cache-first, net-new/entity-level, provenance-tagged, and out of runtime core flows.
BG/EN localization contract is documented for user-facing and searchable entities.
Migration plan keeps DB0 design-only and defers dependencies, migrations, and data movement to DB1+.
Postgres config parsing supports URL and discrete env vars with safe no-config behavior.
Health checks skip cleanly when Postgres is not configured.
Migration files are applied in deterministic order and tracked idempotently with checksums.
DB1 import metadata migration creates source_datasets, source_files, and import_batches.
Import metadata repository normalizes dataset, file, and batch records before source-specific imports exist.
Existing runtime store selection remains independent from Postgres configuration.
Optional real Postgres metadata insert/read flow runs when local Postgres is configured.
